text:
EMSA and RINA take another step towards sharing e-certificate data
The ongoing global digitalisation of administrations and organisations is transforming statutory ship certificates. These documents can now be digitised and shared easily, benefiting both the maritime industry and enforcement authorities.
The classification society RINA and EMSA have successfully completed a second project to transmit SOLAS Safety Equipment SAFEQ certificate data, and to establish a mechanism to further facilitate the validation of electronically issued statutory certificates by enforcement authorities.
This initiative further supports EMSA’s digitisation efforts towards a paperless environment, streamlining access to relevant documents for all stakeholders.
In line with the recently amended Port State Control and Flag State Directive, EMSA aims to develop further value-added services based on e-certificates.
